name: A Change in the Weather
author: Andrew Plotkin; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
description: Walking away from a picnic you are caught in a country storm and must save a bridge. Short and tricky. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin, 1995). Type if-change-in-the-weather in the Terminal or tap the icon.

descriptions.en: Walking away from a picnic you are caught in a country storm and must save a bridge. Short and tricky. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin, 1995). Type if-change-in-the-weather in the Terminal or tap the icon.
descriptions.it: Ti allontani da un picnic e un temporale ti sorprende: devi salvare un ponte. Breve e insidiosa. Avventura testuale in inglese (Andrew Plotkin, 1995). Scrivi if-change-in-the-weather nel Terminale o tocca l'icona.
